question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, which letter will be on the face opposite to the face showing 'H'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f44f2bc4f1a38a8afba7cd3ffb57a35a1015fb902fcf1d1131ea4a0c4262062.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78475b6952432e918f1f8cf5f2f8616804d3bdcfa17b395e4ced357a8e336356.png] 

**Opposite face:**

**⇒ **H ⇔ S

⇒ P ⇔ T

⇒ O ⇔ N

Clearly, S is opposite to H.

Hence, the correct answer is **"S".**
